payload.reason: The evidence provides a comprehensive overview of various types of offensive content explored in social media, including hate speech, cyberbullying, aggression, and insults.

claims.text: Offensive content includes hate speech, cyberbullying, aggression, and toxic comments.
Offensive language can be categorized into targeted insults (TIN) and untargeted profanity (UNT).
The hierarchical model identifies offensive messages based on type and target, including explicit and implicit abusive language.
